$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFRJ (AIP France, chart dated 2024-11-28): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.

notes: Southbound traffic may be prohibited depending on IFR or OAT traffic in progress or expected. plafond / ceiling: 450 m plafond / ceiling: 243 m (800 ft) VIS: 800 m ou 30 SEC de vol / or 30 SEC of fly plafond / ceiling: 183 m (600 ft) Authorization to enter must be requested to LANDIVISIAU APP 5 min before entering points NEL, NWL, EL or SWL.
If failure occurs before having received the entering CLR in CTR: entrance prohibited.
If failure occurs in CTR follow the last CTL instructions.

L'itinéraire Sud peut être interdit en fonction de l'activité IFR ou CAM contrôlée en cours ou prévue. VFR VIS : 5 km ACFT VIS : 4000 m VFR spécial HEL L'autorisation de pénétrer dans la zone est demandée à LANDIVISIAU APP 5 min avant NEL, NWL, EL ou SWL.
Si la panne se produit avant d'avoir reçu la CLR de pénétrer dans la CTR, l'ACFT doit contourner la zone.
Si la panne se produit à l'intérieur de la CTR, suivre les dernières instructions du CTL.
